quirks: Image is returned base64-encoded in candidates[0].content.parts[].inlineData.data (not a URL); mimeType is in the sibling inlineData.mimeType field (observed image/jpeg).
Response can be large (~4.7MB JSON for a single 1024 image) because the base64 image plus a long thoughtSignature string are inlined.
Each part may also include a thoughtSignature field; the actual image part is the one with inlineData.
Standard Google Gemini generateContent request shape: contents is an array of {parts:[{text}]}; contents is the only required field.
usage.guide: POST to the URL with a JSON body whose contents is [{"parts":[{"text":"<your prompt>"}]}] and set generationConfig.responseModalities to ["IMAGE"]. Payment is x402 USDC on Base, ~$0.15/call, plain synchronous (200 returns the result directly). Read the generated image from candidates[0].content.parts[].inlineData.data — it is base64; decode it using the sibling inlineData.mimeType. Optional: generationConfig.imageConfig.aspectRatio / outputSize (up to 4096x4096), and tools:[{"googleSearch":{}}] for grounded images.
